test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘B is the son of A’.

If S @ T # P @ Q # R & V, then how is T related to Q?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given:

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘B is the son of A’.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Relation**
 
 

 @
 Husband

**Given: **S @ T # P @ Q # R & V

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/007a3cd3f5a07d3cdecb9e2fdcc7a9039f5dac3f63527f7b2a7091e054a8b732.png] 

Clearly, T is the Mother-in-law of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Mother-in-law".**
